cues.zh: 大家好！
cues.en: Hey everyone!

cues.zh: 我想跟你们聊聊我刚协调完成的一个超酷项目。
cues.en: I just want to tell you about a really cool project I just finished coordinating.

cues.zh: 不久前，我听说了Martha Lillard，一位来自俄克拉荷马州的美国女士。
cues.en: A while ago, I heard about Martha Lillard, an American lady from Oklahoma.

cues.zh: 我得在地图上找一下——它就在德克萨斯州正上方，人口大约是深圳的四分之一。
cues.en: I had to look for it on a map- it's right above Texas and has a population about a quarter of Shenzhen.

cues.zh: 总之，Martha小时候感染了小儿麻痹症，
cues.en: Anyway, Martha contracted polio when she was a little girl,

cues.zh: 被放进了一种叫铁肺的装置里。
cues.en: and was put into something called an iron lung.

cues.zh: 为了呼吸，她从1953年起每晚都睡在铁肺里。
cues.en: In order to breath she's slept every night in a iron lung since 1953.

cues.zh: 白天她使用所谓的正压呼吸机，
cues.en: During the day she uses what's known as a positive pressure machine,

cues.zh: 但那完全不一样，单靠它她没法真正活下来。
cues.en: but it's just not the same and she can't really survive with it alone.

cues.zh: 看来铁肺有点像手机、游戏机和电脑——
cues.en: It seems that iron lungs are a bit like cellphones, gaming consoles and computers-

cues.zh: 它们推出新东西，说更好，但并不总是真的，
cues.en: they come out with new things they say are better, but that's just not always true,

cues.zh: 或者至少不是对每个人都成立。
cues.en: or at least not true for everyone.

cues.zh: 玛莎试过这些新机器——结果呢，想象一下你的新科技设备让你没法呼吸？
cues.en: Martha tried these new machines- and well, imagine your new tech device meant you couldn't breathe?

cues.zh: 对玛莎和其他几个人来说，几十年来一直如此，
cues.en: For Martha and a few others, that's how it's been for decades,

cues.zh: 他们一直小心维护着呼吸、活命所需的机器，
cues.en: they have carefully maintained the machines they need to breath, to live,

cues.zh: 因为零件越来越稀缺，技术援助也越来越难得。
cues.en: as parts got scarce and technical assistance got more and more rare.

cues.zh: 人们有时会有点不以为然，想象有人对你说——
cues.en: People can be a little dismissive, imagine someone told you-

cues.zh: “哦你不需要这台机器，用这台你能呼吸到50%的效果”绝对不行。
cues.en: "Oh you don't need this machine, you can breath 50% as well with this one" hell no.

cues.zh: 更不用说还有可能发生在年长者身上的其他种种糟糕情况
cues.en: And that's not to mention the risk of all the other bad things that can happen to older

cues.zh: 无法正常呼吸的人。
cues.en: people who can't breath properly.

cues.zh: 这一切又是为了什么？
cues.en: And for what?

cues.zh: 缺少备件？
cues.en: Lack of spare parts?

cues.zh: 那我们那些光鲜的工具和特殊技能还有什么用，
cues.en: Then what are all our shiny tools and special skills good for,

cues.zh: 如果连一个和蔼的小阿姨都救不了，对吧？
cues.en: if we can't save just one nice little auntie, right?

cues.zh: 那纯粹是胡扯，就是做戏。
cues.en: It's just nonsense then, just a show.

cues.zh: 我无法接受。
cues.en: I'm not ok with that.

cues.zh: 哦对了，“阿姨”和“叔叔”是我们中国人对任何年长者的称呼，只是一种尊称。
cues.en: Oh by the way, "auntie" and "uncle" is what we Chinese call anyone older, it's just a term of respect.

cues.zh: 让你们明白我说这话的意思。
cues.en: Just so you know what I mean when I say that.

cues.zh: 铁肺是个很有意思的装置，你的头伸在外面
cues.en: Now an iron lung is an interesting device, your head sticks out

cues.zh: 它靠吸力作用于你的身体，把空气拉进肺里。
cues.en: and it sort of sucks on your body to pull air into your lungs.

cues.zh: 所以脖子周围需要有一圈密封垫。
cues.en: So there needs to be a sort of gasket around your neck.

cues.zh: 金属部件不成问题——从焊工到钟表匠
cues.en: The metal parts are no problem- welders-to-watchmakers

cues.zh: 我觉得没有哪种金属制品是我搞不到的。
cues.en: I think there's nothing made out of metal I couldn't source.

cues.zh: 但那个密封垫、那个领口非常棘手。
cues.en: But that gasket, that collar was very tricky.

cues.zh: 它像光圈一样收拢闭合，尺寸必须刚刚好，材料也必须刚刚好，
cues.en: It kind of irises closed and has to be just the right size, just the right material,

cues.zh: 弹性还要恰到好处。
cues.en: with just the right amount of elasticity.

cues.zh: 大家都说“哦这看起来很简单”，确实看起来简单——
cues.en: Everyone said "oh it looks easy" and it does-

cues.zh: 这些年来很多人尝试过，但从来没能完全贴合。
cues.en: and a lot of people tried over the years but it never fit quite right.

cues.zh: 这意味着它周围漏气，铁肺就无法正常工作。
cues.en: Which means the air leaks around it, and the iron lung can't do it's job.

cues.zh: 看来需要的不仅仅是一个会用缝纫机的人。
cues.en: It seems it needed more than just a person handy with a sewing machine.

cues.zh: 人们往往低估了纺织品能有多棘手。
cues.en: People tend to underestimate how tricky textiles can be.

cues.zh: 还有很多浪费时间的人想耍小聪明——
cues.en: And a lot of time wasters wanted to play clever-

cues.zh: 说他们能重新设计出更好的东西，但很快就失去了兴趣。
cues.en: said they could redesign something better but quickly lost interest.

cues.zh: Martha需要的是一件绝对完美的复制品——
cues.en: What Martha needed was an absolutely perfect copy-

cues.zh: 而这一生中，我第一次为自己来自一个
cues.en: and for once in my life, I was proud that I come from someplace

cues.zh: 几乎能精确复制任何东西的地方而自豪！
cues.en: that can make an exact clone of almost anything!

cues.zh: 但时间不多了，Martha只剩最后一个领圈了，而且它在漏气——
cues.en: But, there wasn't much time, Martha was down to her last collar, and it was leaking-

cues.zh: 所以机器无法帮她正常呼吸。
cues.en: so the machine could not help her breath properly.

cues.zh: 她把她那个旧的、磨损的寄给了我。
cues.en: She sent me her old, worn out one.

cues.zh: 我在深圳很难收到包裹，它们会被海关扣下
cues.en: It's hard for me to get packages in Shenzhen, they get stopped by customs

cues.zh: 所以我让它寄到香港，然后过境去把它带回来。
cues.en: so I had it mailed to Hong Kong and went over the border to bring it back over.

cues.zh: 然后我在微信上向我在中国各个城市的所有技术联系人发出了号召。
cues.en: Then I put out the call on WeChat to all my tech contacts in every city in China.

cues.zh: 我的说辞是什么？
cues.en: My pitch?

cues.zh: 我们得拯救……“钢铁阿姨”。
cues.en: We Have To Save..."Iron Auntie."

cues.zh: 听着，这就像她的方舟反应炉坏了，她需要这个布料部件才能活下去。
cues.en: Get this, it's like her arc reactor is broken, and she needs this cloth part to live.

cues.zh: 你再也写不出比这更好的剧情来动员中国人为一个事业行动了。
cues.en: You could not write a better plot-line to get Chinese mobilized for a cause.

cues.zh: 所有中国人都爱钢铁侠，当然你们也知道我们对长辈的态度
cues.en: All Chinese love Iron Man, and of course you know how we are about our elders

cues.zh: 而且我们还能看看谁能完美复制一样东西？
cues.en: and we get to see who can copy something perfectly?

cues.zh: 嗯，大家都想展示自己的大学、自己的研发实验室、自己的工程师能做什么。
cues.en: Well, everyone wanted to show off what their university, their R&D lab, their engineers could do.

cues.zh: 而且我基本上给他们开了一张空白支票，只要他们帮我做这件事，未来他们想要的任何YouTube推广
cues.en: And it probably didn't hurt that I gave pretty much a blank check for any YouTube

cues.zh: 大概都不成问题，这估计也没什么坏处。
cues.en: promotion they might ever want in the future if they did this for me.

cues.zh: 这些人里很多都有众筹产品想要推广——相信我，
cues.en: A lot of these people have crowdfunding products that they want to promote- and believe me,

cues.zh: 等他们来兑现这张人情牌时，我会拼命推广他们的产品，
cues.en: when they call in that marker I'm going to promote the heck out of their product without

cues.zh: 毫不羞愧。
cues.en: an ounce of shame.

cues.zh: 我根本不在乎那是什么，反正那些人会得到照顾的。
cues.en: I don't even care what it is, those folks are getting taken care of.

cues.zh: 我联系上了Will Wu——不是亲戚，他是一位工程师兼创业者，做了大量
cues.en: I got in touch with Will Wu- no relation, an engineer and entrepreneur who does a lot

cues.zh: 硬件嵌入式纺织品方面的工作。
cues.en: of work with hardware embedded textiles.

cues.zh: 他目前的产品是一款放松面罩——Dreamlight。
cues.en: His current product is a relaxation mask- the Dreamlight.

cues.zh: 认识他的人都这么说，就是这家伙了。
cues.en: Everyone who knew him said, this is the guy.

cues.zh: 在中国，人们这么坚定地担保，那是有分量的。
cues.en: And in China, when people vouch that firmly it means something.

cues.zh: 如果是那种“哦行吧，老王也许能搞定”，那他们其实心里没底。
cues.en: When it's like "oh yeah sure, Old Wong can maybe do it" sure they have no clue.

cues.zh: 但当所有人都说“毫无疑问，Will Wu就是你要找的人”——
cues.en: But when everyone is like "No question, Will Wu is your guy"-

cues.zh: 那Will Wu就是那个人。
cues.en: well, Will Wu is the guy.

cues.zh: 尤其是因为他们都有点怕我，
cues.en: Particularly because they're all a little scared of me and

cues.zh: 知道要是给我推荐错了人会有什么后果。
cues.en: know what will happen if they send me to the wrong guy.

cues.zh: 毕竟我可是朵温顺乖巧的中国小花。
cues.en: Because I'm such a sweet docile Chinese flower.

cues.zh: 所以我放心地把Martha铁肺项圈的唯一样品交给了Will，
cues.en: So I trusted Will with my only sample of Martha's Iron Lung collar,

cues.zh: 祈祷好运，然后寄给了Will的工程团队。
cues.en: crossed my fingers and sent it to Will's engineering team.

cues.zh: 然后……两周后，我拿到了什么？
cues.en: Now...two weeks later and what do I have?

cues.zh: 瞧瞧这个，伙计们、姑娘们——发往俄克拉荷马——10个完美的复制品。
cues.en: Well check this out buckaroos and buckerettes- bound for Oklahoma- 10 perfect copies.

cues.zh: 说到完美复制品，我是用数显游标卡尺量过的，
cues.en: And when I say perfect copies I measured these with the digital caliper,

cues.zh: 我都不知道他们怎么做到的，我该让他们去做胸罩什么的。
cues.en: I don't even know how they did it because I should have them make bras or something.

cues.zh: 在我看来、手上、仪器上，我们都做到了
cues.en: Now to my eyes, hands, and instruments we nailed it

cues.zh: 但我留了几个，以防有问题
cues.en: BUT I'm saving a few so that if there's a problem

cues.zh: 我可以改一下再发一批，如果没问题，我就能多做些
cues.en: I can get them altered and send another batch, and if there isn't, I can get more made

cues.zh: 按平均一年一个领子算，我能确保我们70岁的
cues.en: and at an average of one collar a year I can make sure our 70-year-old

cues.zh: 铁阿姨有足够的零件让她的“方舟反应堆”运转到她120岁高龄。
cues.en: Iron Auntie has enough parts to keep her "arc reactor" running until she's a nice ripe 120 years old.

cues.zh: 希望你们和我一样对这个项目满意。
cues.en: I hope you're as happy with this project as I am.

cues.zh: 请看看描述栏里Will Wu的Dreamlight链接，他是个好人。
cues.en: Please check out the link to Will Wu's Dreamlight in the description box, he's good people.

cues.zh: 最后，创客运动给我们带来了一些很棒的想法，
cues.en: Lastly, the Maker movement has brought us some wonderful ideas,

cues.zh: 但主要还是围绕教育和乐趣。
cues.en: but has been mostly about education and fun.

cues.zh: 也有一些像3D打印假手这样的项目，但这确实一直不是核心价值。
cues.en: There's some work with stuff like 3D printed prosthetic hands but it really hasn't been a core value.

cues.zh: 硬件黑客都热衷于分享——
cues.en: Hardware hackers are all about sharing-

cues.zh: 我有这个，我希望你也能拥有。
cues.en: I have this, I want you to have this also.

cues.zh: 对我来说，我想加强我对服务的承诺。
cues.en: For me, I want to strengthen my commitment to service.

cues.zh: 那些有工具和技能的人——请考虑一下。
cues.en: Those of you with tools and skills- please think about it.

cues.zh: YouTube上已经有足够多的东西被压碎、炸毁、建模和测试了。
cues.en: YouTube's got enough things being crushed, blown up, modeled and tested.

cues.zh: 让我们把其中一些资源投入到有产出的事情上——
cues.en: Let's put some of those resources into something productive-

cues.zh: 看起来也一样酷。
cues.en: it will be just as cool to watch.

cues.zh: 在你的车库上挂个牌子，去趟养老院，想想本地社区。
cues.en: Put a sign on your garage, drop by a senior home, think local.

cues.zh: 我们无法拯救世界，
cues.en: We can't save the world,

cues.zh: 但我们可以把自己的技能和资源用好，并在此过程中挑战自己。
cues.en: but we can put our skills and resources to good use and in doing so challenge ourselves.

cues.zh: 请考虑多做一些动手制作和 DIY 项目，去帮助你们
cues.en: Please consider taking on more Making and DIY projects in the service of those in your

cues.zh: 社区里真正需要帮助、别处求助无门、可能还不知道有创客、
cues.en: community who genuinely need help, can't get it elsewhere, and may not be aware that Makers,

cues.zh: 硬件和 DIY 爱好者存在的人——
cues.en: hardware and DIY enthusiasts-

cues.zh: 我们能做出他们只在电视上见过的东西，也很乐意为了好事业展示自己的技能。
cues.en: well, we can do stuff they've only seen on TV and we love to show off our skills for a good cause.

cues.zh: 谢谢。
cues.en: Thank you.

cues.zh: 今天就到这里，我们下次见。
cues.en: That's it for today and I'll see you all next time.
